name: Narukawa Iris
source:
"Hayato was raised single-handedly by me! I will never let him go!"

A petite mom with an interest in cosplay. Her true identity is the reincarnated goddess Alice, conceived with the soul of a demon god while still a virgin. Crafty and devious, she has a mother-in-law vibe, frequently indulging in physical contact due to excessive pampering of her son.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294690/Yomegami_My_Sweet_Goddess/]Steam[/url]]
